app.name: IR Remote
app.tagline: Control your TV and air conditioner from your phone.

auth.name: Name
auth.forgotHelp: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.linkSent: If the email exists, we sent you a link. Check your inbox.

home.title: My devices
home.emptyText: Add your first TV or air conditioner to get started.

add.title: New device
add.idHelp: Enter the ID printed on your IR device.
add.typeTitle: What do you want to control?

setup.title: Setup
setup.listeningHelp: Point your original remote at the IR device and press the button.
setup.instruction: Press the "{{action}}" button on your original remote control, pointing at the IR device.
setup.acInstruction: Set your air conditioner to the state you want (for example, on) and press the power button on its original remote, pointing at the IR device.
setup.acStateOk: Your AC is supported. This single capture lets you control power, mode, temperature, fan and swing.
setup.acRawInfo: This model doesn't support automatic mode. We'll set up each button separately.

remote.offlineHint: The IR device is offline. Buttons are disabled.

edit.title: Edit remote
edit.deleteConfirm: Delete this remote and its buttons?

settings.title: Settings
settings.installText: Add it to your home screen to open it instantly.
settings.installIos: In Safari, tap Share and then "Add to Home Screen".
